goal: Sign on to the MeridianCore servicing console and open Member Servicing. Look up the member whose number is given by the member_id input. From that member's record, open Stop Payment. On the request form, leave the Draft Account at the account already selected, enter the Check Number, the Check Amount and the Requested By name from the inputs of the same names, and choose the reason "Check lost or stolen". Then place the stop payment. The flow is only complete when the confirmation screen is on screen: read the Reference Number and the Request Status from it.
step_intent: Submit the stop payment request to observe the host fault in the deliberately broken sandbox state
reason: control 'Place Stop Payment' is marked human-only by profile 'default'; automation must hand off
